visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Explicit Values Are Missing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: MEDIUM should be 5 and HIGH should be 10, but they are printed as 1 and 2.

solution.explanation: Without = the names are numbered automatically: LOW is 0, MEDIUM is 1 and HIGH is 2. When the numbers matter (for example as thresholds), set them explicitly.
